summary: Full backend + frontend testing of Nexus AI. Backend: 15/15 pytest cases passing (root, dashboard metrics/activity, leads signals+scan, pipeline CRUD/PATCH, onboarding create/latest/get, real Claude Sonnet 4.5 targets generation 8-10 cards, 404/400 edge cases). Frontend: Landing renders (hero, bento metrics, features, agents, pricing, final CTA, footer); Launch App routes to /app/dashboard; Dashboard shows activity-feed (14 rows), agent-fleet, forecast-panel; Lead Engine shows 17 signals and scan added 4 new ones (17->21); Pipeline kanban has 5 stage columns + 12 cards and deal-next chevron successfully advanced prospecting -> qualified via PATCH; Beta Onboarding wizard 4 steps + real LLM call rendered 10 high-quality targets twice (different companies each run => fresh Claude calls). No console errors, no _id leaks in any response.

minor.issue: Returns 200 (default FastAPI) instead of 201 Created - minor REST hygiene

action_items: (optional) Return 201 status on POST /api/pipeline/deals and /api/onboarding for REST correctness.

(optional) On /app/onboarding page mount, if a latest profile exists you currently auto-show results — consider explicit user opt-in or clearer 'restart' affordance (works today via restart-onboarding testid).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — migrate to lifespan context manager for FastAPI >= 0.100.

TARGETS_SYSTEM_PROMPT relies on raw JSON from the LLM; current parser handles ``` fences but could fail on stray prose. Consider response_format/JSON-mode if supported, or jsonschema validation with re-prompt on failure.
/api/targets/generate deletes prior targets for profile then inserts — if the LLM produces 0 valid rows the user is left with empty state. Wrap in transaction or only delete after successful parse.
Frontend Onboarding page assumes a single global 'latest' profile from /api/onboarding/latest — there is no user/session scoping (acceptable since spec says no auth).
Backend has no rate-limit/abuse protection on /api/targets/generate which makes a paid LLM call (acceptable for MVP, flag for prod).
test_credentials: N/A - no auth in this app
seed_data_creation: Backend seeds 12 signals / 11 deals / 12 activities on startup; tests created TEST_Convex Labs profile + 1 TEST_AcmeCorp deal and two LLM-generated target sets (auto-replaced on each /targets/generate by design).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All endpoints + flows verified. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_nexus_backend.py covers full backend including a real Claude Sonnet 4.5 call (~30s). The frontend Onboarding page auto-loads latest profile + its targets — use restart-onboarding testid to access wizard. Pipeline kanban deal-next testid advances stage via PATCH. /api/onboarding/latest returns null when no profiles exist (Optional model). Useful sample profile payload in test file constant PROFILE_PAYLOAD.
rca of the issue: No issues found. Real LLM integration confirmed working twice with diverse, high-quality, schema-conformant outputs (8-10 cards, fit_score sorted desc).
